official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: World2 Interior is an agent-guided 3D room design tool for measured spaces and editable layouts. Create an empty room shell or a furnished design with the available published parametric catalog, read the current design and edit furniture and supported room finishes. Remove furniture or undo a change, then inspect a read-only 3D scene. Anonymous drafts require a private creation credential for edits and cannot be retrieved from a public viewer link. Unpublished furniture or geometry changes needing offline Blender generation are not immediately available. Reference photos do not supply verified room measurements; this tool does not ingest uploads, download model source, arrange physical deliveries or take payments.
